issue.title: Day strip legend items overlap each other when root labels are long

task_type_fields.impact:
Any day whose top roots have long labels (long project file stems are common,
e.g. `job_2026_apply_29`) gets an unreadable legend line in the Day strip on
every daily note; the docs promise legend labels never ellipsize and that the
narrow counter hides extras, but nothing protects the wide layout. Fix by
letting items keep their content width (`flex: none`) and dropping trailing
items into the `+N` counter, or by clipping each item, and add a harness check
that compares each visible legend item's `scrollWidth` with its box.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-ledger-tools/styles.css .bob-day-strip-legend-item (min-width: 0) and scripts/preview-day-strip.template.html legend overlap check
task_type_fields.repro:
In bob-plugins, render the Day strip preview matrix:

```sh
npm run build
node scripts/preview-day-strip.cjs --out /tmp/bob-day-strip-preview
```

Open `day-strip-540-dark.png` (or 700/410) and find the **Long labels** cell
(fixture `longLabels`, roots such as `job_2026_apply_29 long root` and
`Long Systems Research 1`). The legend row reads as overlapping text —
`job_2026_apply_29 lo…` paints over `Long Systems Research…`, which paints over
`Long Personal Develo…` and the values `25m` / `102m` — while the matrix still
reports `pass` with legend overlap 0px. Seen on bob-plugins origin/master
a61d907 and on the redesign prototype alike.

Root cause (high confidence): `.bob-day-strip-legend-item` is an
`inline-flex` item with `min-width: 0` inside the `overflow: hidden`
`.bob-day-strip-legend` flex row, so long items shrink below their content
width but their text stays `overflow: visible` and paints over the next item.
The harness's legend checks compare the shrunken item boxes (and label
truncation) rather than each item's `scrollWidth` against its box, so they
cannot see it.

issue.creation_reason: Found while prototyping the Day strip stat-row redesign: the long-labels preview cell shows overlapping legend text that the preview matrix reports as passing.

payload.description: Same Day strip surface (bob-ledger-tools day-strip fragments); independent defect, but both touch the strip and its docs
Need task details for legend overflow defect

payload.entry: Resolved on bob-plugins master by 41f2093 (concurrent agent 14i: flex:none legend items plus a measured fit pass that drops lowest-minute roots into one +N counter whose title lists them, with a names-only fallback) and batch-12 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.5 commit abb6ea6, which added the item-level legendItemOverflow check (scrollWidth vs box) to the preview harness. The phase showed the check fails on the old min-width:0 CSS for longLabels at 410/540/700 light+dark (26-127 px) and passes with the fix (114 cells, 0 failures). docs/stats.md (bob-cli 69dfd7e8) documents the fit/+N behavior. Lander verified the vault bob-ledger-tools 1.73.0 main.js and styles.css are byte-identical to master.
